user.title: Set up HCL Lighting
user.description: Configure the Human Centric Lighting integration. The anchor times create the default curve; it can be edited later in the dashboard card.

error.active_span_too_short: Wake and sleep time must be more than 6 hours apart.

init.title: HCL Lighting options
init.description: A curve saved in the dashboard card has priority over the anchor times. Changing wake, midday or sleep time discards it and creates a new default curve.

data.brightness_scaling: Scale to min/max instead of clipping

data_description.brightness_scaling: Off (default): curve values outside min/max are clipped. On: the curve range 10–100 % is mapped onto min–max, the shape of the curve is kept.

data.turn_on_transition: Transition when a light is switched on
data.override_timeout: Return to HCL after manual control (min, 0 = never)
data.override_reset_on_off: Switching a light off ends manual control
data.respect_turn_on_values: Keep values of turn-on commands (scenes, automations, voice)

data_description.transition: Seconds; must be shorter than the update interval (default 20). Lights without transition support ignore it.
data_description.respect_turn_on_values: If a light is switched on through Home Assistant with its own brightness or colour, HCL leaves it as it is (manual control).
data_description.scenario_transition: Seconds (default: same as the update transition). Also used when a scenario ends and returns to Auto; may be longer than the update interval.

data.night_end_at_wake: Sleep and Night light end at the wake time

data_description.scenario_limits: Off (default): scenarios use their own values. On: their brightness stays within min/max. The night light is not limited.
data_description.night_end_at_wake: On: Sleep and Night light switch back to Auto at the wake time.

error.min_greater_max: Minimum brightness must be lower than maximum.
error.transition_too_long: The transition must be shorter than the update interval.
error.active_span_too_short: Wake and sleep time must be more than 6 hours apart.

update_curve.name: Update curve
update_curve.description: Update the HCL control points (used by the dashboard card).

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: The HCL switch or curve sensor.

points.name: Control points
points.description: Control points with t (0-1440 min), b (0-100 %) and k (2000-7000 K), at least 2, each time only once. Not used for revert.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: preview/apply: use the points until the next reload; save: store them; revert: reload the saved curve.

apply.name: Apply HCL values
apply.description: Sends the current HCL values to lights that are on right away. Never switches lights on; lights under manual control are skipped.

entity_id.name: HCL instance
entity_id.description: Any entity of the HCL instance (switch, scenario or sensor).

lights.name: Lights
lights.description: Lights of the instance; empty = all.

release_manual_control.name: Release manual control
release_manual_control.description: Also hand lights under manual control back to HCL.

set_manual_control.name: Set manual control
set_manual_control.description: Pauses HCL for lights (on) or hands them back to HCL (off).

entity_id.name: HCL instance
entity_id.description: Any entity of the HCL instance (switch, scenario or sensor).

lights.name: Lights
lights.description: Lights of the instance; empty = all.

manual_control.name: Manual control
manual_control.description: On: HCL pauses the lights; off: they follow HCL again.

set_scenario.name: Set scenario
set_scenario.description: Selects a scenario, optionally for a duration.

entity_id.name: HCL instance
entity_id.description: Any entity of the HCL instance (switch, scenario or sensor).

scenario.name: Scenario
scenario.description: auto, sleep, night_light, focus, relax, cleaning or guest.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Minutes until the return to Auto (0 = until changed). Empty = as configured.

get_curve.name: Get curve
get_curve.description: Returns the points of the active and the saved curve and the anchor times (e.g. to copy them to another instance with update_curve).

entity_id.name: HCL instance
entity_id.description: Any entity of the HCL instance (switch, scenario or sensor).

light_in_multiple_instances.title: Light in several HCL instances
light_in_multiple_instances.description: {light} is controlled by several HCL instances ({instances}) that adapt the same attribute. They overwrite each other. Remove the light from one instance or turn off “Adapt brightness” or “Adapt colour temperature” there.
